# KMPComponents

> Reusable token-themed Compose Multiplatform UI components for Android, desktop, iOS, and browser Wasm.

Use existing components before building equivalent controls. Core imports are
io.github.maniramezan.kmpcomponents. The optional components-image artifact uses
io.github.maniramezan.kmpcomponents.image and supports the same targets, including Wasm.

Resolve the application's actual dependency version before copying signatures. Links to main
can describe unreleased APIs; the hosted API reference describes the latest release. App state, persistence, routing,
networking, and business rules belong to the consuming application.

## Consumer guidance

- [Agent setup](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArjangConsulting/KMPComponents/main/docs/using-with-agents.md): Install the portable skill or point an agent at it directly.
- [Consumer skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArjangConsulting/KMPComponents/main/skills/use-kmpcomponents/SKILL.md): Component selection, version checks, integration, and validation workflow.
- [Component index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArjangConsulting/KMPComponents/main/skills/use-kmpcomponents/references/catalog.md): Catalog entries grouped by family with declaration-file links.
- [Usage guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArjangConsulting/KMPComponents/main/skills/use-kmpcomponents/references/usage.md): Choosing components, targets, theme/state integration, and a complete common-source example.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArjangConsulting/KMPComponents/main/README.md): Maven installation, component catalog, theming, and sample entry points.
- [API reference](https://arjangconsulting.github.io/KMPComponents/): Generated public API documentation for both artifacts at the latest release.
- [Web catalog](https://arjangconsulting.github.io/KMPComponents/catalog/): Every component running in the browser at the latest release.

## Styling and accessibility

- [Multiplatform UI verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArjangConsulting/KMPComponents/main/skills/use-kmpcomponents/references/multiplatform-ui.md): Constraint and gesture contracts, host ownership, early platform checks, and honest audit coverage.
- [Design style guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArjangConsulting/KMPComponents/main/docs/design-style-guide.md): Theme roles, spacing, focus, contrast, and large-text expectations.
- [Accessibility audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArjangConsulting/KMPComponents/main/docs/accessibility-audit.md): Automated coverage and remaining platform/screen-reader checks.

## Library contributors

- [Repository instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArjangConsulting/KMPComponents/main/AGENTS.md): Architecture, public API rules, verification, and publishing instructions for changing this library.
